description:
NSWCPD has a requirement for UMM Adaptor Block and Spare Parts.  The drawings associated with this requirement have a distribution D CUI statement.  To view the RFQ and drawings, a JCP Certification must be submitted.  Please send your company's JCP Certification to zachary.f.mccurry.civ@us.navy.mil.  This requirement is currently being solicited as a total small business set aside.  This pre-solicitation notice closes on 04/07/2026.  The RFQ and drawings will be issued AFTER the closing of the pre-solicitation notice. 

Please email all questions to zachary.f.mccurry.civ@us.navy.mil

Phone calls will NOT be accepted.
